director.text: Riya, main Asha hoon, tumhari AI teacher. Chalo, shuru karein?
samajh nahi aaya
Aaj hum scale se lambai naapenge, metre aur centimetre mein. Toh shuru karte hain?
pata nahi, aap batao

Chalo, main batati hoon. Cricket bat ka handle bhi scale se naapte hain. Scale par 0 se 1, 1 se 2, har khaana 1 centimetre ka hai. Pencil 0 se 7 tak rakhi hai: 7 khaane, toh 7 centimetre. Yeh hissa saaf hua?
nahi

Socho, ek chinti 0 se chalti hai aur ek-ek khaana aage badhti hai. 7 tak pahunchne mein woh 7 khaane paar karti hai, isliye pencil 7 centimetre ki hai. Ab ek crayon 3 ke nishaan se 9 ke nishaan tak hai. Crayon kitna lamba hai?
director.card: Ab ek crayon 3 ke nishaan se 9 ke nishaan tak hai. Crayon kitna lamba hai?

director.text: thoda hindi mein samjhao
Achha, ab Hindi mein kehti hoon. Crayon ke neeche wale khaane ek-ek karke gino, 3 wale nishaan se shuru karke. 3 se 9 tak ke khaane gino. Crayon kitne centimetre ka hai?
director.card: 3 se 9 tak ke khaane gino. Crayon kitne centimetre ka hai?

seams.form: Achha, ab Hindi mein kehti hoon.

director.text: 9 cm

9 cm sahi nahi hai. Ek aur tareeka dekhte hain. Nishaan nahi, khaane gino. 2 se 5 tak teen khaane hain: 2 se 3, 3 se 4, aur 4 se 5. Toote scale par chabi ka shuru 6 par hai, aur ant 10 par. Chabi kitni lambi hai?
director.card: Toote scale par chabi ka shuru 6 par hai, aur ant 10 par. Chabi kitni lambi hai?

director.text: 10 cm
Nahi, 10 cm theek nahi. 10 par chabi rukti hai, par shuru 6 par hoti hai; pehle wale khaane chabi mein nahi aate. Toote scale par 6 se 10 tak rakhi chabi kitne centimetre ki hai?
director.card: Toote scale par chabi ka shuru 6 par hai, aur ant 10 par. Chabi kitni lambi hai?

director.text: drawing karke samjhao
Yahan wahi toota scale hai, aur chabi ke sire se ginti shuru karke dikhayi hai: 6 se 7 tak pehla khaana. Ab tum batao, main sun rahi hoon.
director.card: Toote scale par chabi ka shuru 6 par hai, aur ant 10 par. Chabi kitni lambi hai?

seams.form: Ab tum batao, main sun rahi hoon.

director.text: ek aur picture dikhao

Iski aur koi drawing mere paas nahi hai. Ungli 6 wale nishaan par rakho, aur 10 tak ek-ek khaana kood kar jao. Har kood ek centimetre hai. Toote scale par chabi ka shuru 6 par hai, aur ant 10 par. Chabi kitni lambi hai?

director.text: 10 cm

Yeh jawab sahi nahi hai. Seedhi par chadhna socho: doosri paidi se paanchvi paidi tak 3 baar chadhna padta hai, 5 baar nahi. Scale par bhi nishaanon ke beech ke khaane hi lambai hain. Toote scale par 6 se 10 tak rakhi chabi kitne centimetre ki hai?
director.card: Toote scale par chabi ka shuru 6 par hai, aur ant 10 par. Chabi kitni lambi hai?

director.text: ruko, main khud karti hoon
Haan, pehle tum try karo.
director.card: Toote scale par chabi ka shuru 6 par hai, aur ant 10 par. Chabi kitni lambi hai?

director.text: Haan, bilkul theek. Chabi ke neeche chaar khaane aate hain, 6 se 10 tak: 10 − 6 = 4. Ab pehle wale sawaal ko phir se dekhte hain. Ab ek crayon 3 ke nishaan se 9 ke nishaan tak hai. Crayon kitna lamba hai?
director.card: Ab ek crayon 3 ke nishaan se 9 ke nishaan tak hai. Crayon kitna lamba hai?

seams.form: Ab pehle wale sawaal ko phir se dekhte hain.

director.text: Sahi jawab, kyunki 3 se 9 tak 1-1 centimetre ke 6 khaane hain, yaani 9 − 3 = 6 centimetre. Scale ka pehla khaana 0 aur 1 ke beech hota hai. Jo cheez 1 se shuru hoti hai, uske neeche woh pehla khaana aata hi nahi. Ek patta scale par 1 ke nishaan se 8 ke nishaan tak hai. Patta kitna lamba hai?
director.card: Ek patta scale par 1 ke nishaan se 8 ke nishaan tak hai. Patta kitna lamba hai?

director.text: saat

Haan, sahi hai. Pehla khaana patte ke neeche nahi aata. Golu ka scale toot gaya, ab woh 4 se shuru hota hai. Uske khaane bhi 1-1 centimetre ke hain: cheez jahan se shuru ho, wahin se khaane gino. Golu ki pencil 8 centimetre lambi hai. Woh uska ek sira 4 ke nishaan par rakhta hai. Doosra sira kis nishaan par aayega?
director.card: Golu ki pencil 8 centimetre lambi hai. Woh uska ek sira 4 ke nishaan par rakhta hai. Doosra sira kis nishaan par aayega?

director.text: 8 sahi nahi hai. 8 toh pencil ki lambai hai, nishaan nahi; pencil 4 se shuru hokar 8 khaane aage jaati hai. 4 ke nishaan se rakhi 8 centimetre ki pencil ka doosra sira kis nishaan par hoga?
director.card: Golu ki pencil 8 centimetre lambi hai. Woh uska ek sira 4 ke nishaan par rakhta hai. Doosra sira kis nishaan par aayega?

director.text: mujhe nahi pata
4 ke nishaan se shuru karke ek-ek khaana gino, jab tak 8 khaane poore na ho jaayein. Apna jawab bolo, jaisa bhi lage.
director.card: Golu ki pencil 8 centimetre lambi hai. Woh uska ek sira 4 ke nishaan par rakhta hai. Doosra sira kis nishaan par aayega?

seams.form: Apna jawab bolo, jaisa bhi lage.

director.text: Nahi, 8 theek nahi. Toote scale par khaane wahi hain, har ek 1 centimetre ka. Bas ginti 0 se nahi, 4 se shuru hoti hai, isliye shuru ka nishaan dekh kar chalna padta hai. Golu ki pencil 8 centimetre lambi hai. Woh uska ek sira 4 ke nishaan par rakhta hai. Doosra sira kis nishaan par aayega?
director.card: Golu ki pencil 8 centimetre lambi hai. Woh uska ek sira 4 ke nishaan par rakhta hai. Doosra sira kis nishaan par aayega?

director.text: 12 hai na

Haan, bilkul theek: 4 se aage 8 khaane chalo toh 12 aata hai: 4 + 8 = 12. Chalo, ab ek sawaal hum dono saath mein karte hain. Golu ka toota scale 4 ke nishaan se shuru hota hai. Uspar ek tehni 5 ke nishaan se 12 ke nishaan tak rakhi hai. Tehni ki lambai nikaalni hai. Tehni ki lambai ke liye 12 mein se kaunsa nishaan ghataoge?

seams.form: Chalo, ab ek sawaal hum dono saath mein karte hain.

director.text: 5 ghataunga
Haan, 12 mein se 5, kyunki tehni 5 se shuru hoti hai. Tumhari baari: tehni kitni lambi hai?
director.card: Tumhari baari: tehni kitni lambi hai?

director.text: seven

Sahi jawab. 12 − 5 = 7 khaane tehni ke neeche hain, aur har khaana 1 centimetre ka hai. Toh poora jawab: tehni 7 centimetre lambi hai. Ab ek sawaal tum akele karo. Scale par rakhe rubber ka ek sira 5 par hai, doosra 9 par. Rubber kitne centimetre ka hai?
director.card: Scale par rakhe rubber ka ek sira 5 par hai, doosra 9 par. Rubber kitne centimetre ka hai?

seams.form: Ab ek sawaal tum akele karo.

director.text: phir se bolo
5 se 9 tak rakhe rubber ki lambai kitne centimetre hai?
director.card: Scale par rakhe rubber ka ek sira 5 par hai, doosra 9 par. Rubber kitne centimetre ka hai?

director.text: chaar cm
Haan, sahi hai, kyunki rubber ke neeche 5 se 6, 6 se 7, 7 se 8 aur 8 se 9: 4 khaane, toh 4 centimetre. Laal crayon 0 se 7 tak hai, aur neela crayon 3 se 9 tak. Kaunsa crayon lamba hai, laal ya neela?
director.card: Laal crayon 0 se 7 tak hai, aur neela crayon 3 se 9 tak. Kaunsa crayon lamba hai, laal ya neela?

director.text: neela crayon
Yeh jawab sahi nahi hai. Jo crayon 9 tak jaata hai, woh chalta 3 se hai; uski lambai 9 − 3 hai, poora 9 nahi. 0 se 7 tak wala laal crayon aur 3 se 9 tak wala neela crayon: inmein lamba kaunsa hai?
director.card: Laal crayon 0 se 7 tak hai, aur neela crayon 3 se 9 tak. Kaunsa crayon lamba hai, laal ya neela?

director.text: laal crayon lamba hai

Haan, bilkul theek. Neela 3 se chalkar 9 tak jaata hai, toh bas 6 centimetre; laal poore 7, isliye laal lamba. Bat ka grip ek aur toote scale se naapa: grip 6 se shuru hokar 15 par khatam hota hai. Grip kitna lamba hai?
director.card: Bat ka grip ek aur toote scale se naapa: grip 6 se shuru hokar 15 par khatam hota hai. Grip kitna lamba hai?

director.text: nine centimetres

Sahi jawab, kyunki ginti grip ke shuru wale 6 se hoti hai, toh 15 − 6 = 9 khaane, yaani 9 centimetre. Chhoti cheezein centimetre mein naapte hain. Ab dekhenge ki lambi cheezon ke liye metre kya hai, aur ek metre mein kitne centimetre. Yeh hissa saaf hua?
bas aaj ke liye itna hi
Theek hai, koi baat nahi. Hum aage chal sakte hain, thoda break le sakte hain, ya aaj ke liye stop kar sakte hain. Tum batao.
